title: Frame Perfect
subtitle: Build a tool-assisted speedrun toolkit, and use it to beat a par the game's own rules say is impossible
lead: Kettle is a small platformer whose developers shipped two physics bugs without knowing. Build the tools speedrunners use: an input-movie player, savestates, a desync finder, a memory watch, a model of the jump, searches that prove a route is the fastest, a movie minimiser and a way to steer the random generator. Then use them to beat a par time that Kettle's own rules say cannot be beaten. You never edit the game: every claim you make is a movie, and code you did not write replays it.
prerequisites: JavaScript functions, loops, arrays, Map and Set. Node.js 22 or newer. Breadth-first search met once is enough; module 5 builds it from the start.
scope: Not covered: emulators, real console games, machine learning, drawing code.
runtime: Node 22 or newer. Git for module 3. A browser to watch movies (optional). No packages, account or network.
